name: osm_find_nearby
description: Find POIs of a category near a place, address, or coordinates. Returns a compact markdown list with distance and OSM link.

arguments.name: place
arguments.desc: Place/address/coordinates to search around (include city/country when ambiguous).

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: POI category key (food, groceries, pharmacies, public_transport, …).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of items to return (1..30).

name: osm_find_place
description: Resolve a specific named place, landmark, or address.

name: osm_find_address
description: Reverse-geocode coordinates to likely places or addresses via Nominatim /reverse.

name: osm_geocode
description: Convert a place/address into GPS coordinates (no full address details).

name: osm_directions
description: Route summary and step-by-step directions A -> B with ordered steps, distance, and duration.

name: osm_get_health
description: Operational health snapshot: uptime, per-tool call/error counters, last upstream failure, cache path.

name: osm_get_security_metrics
description: In-memory security counter snapshot (URL policy blocks, auth failures, upstream failures, …).

name: osm_get_version
description: Server version and process start timestamp.
